buyBody: Tour performance grips with the clover worked into the pattern, in green. Grips are the only part of the club you actually touch and they are the part almost nobody replaces often enough. Only Standard is in stock at the moment.

details.headline: The only part of the club you touch
paras: A worn grip makes you hold on tighter, and holding on tighter is the fastest way to ruin a swing. Most golfers go years without changing them.
These cost under fifteen dollars. Change them.

details.headline: Standard, midsize, jumbo
paras: Bigger grips quieten the hands; smaller ones let them work. If your hands are large or you tend to flip through impact, go up a size.
Price goes up with size, which is why the buy box repaints when you choose.
